category_title: Adolescents who engage in truant behavior to maintain peer connections during school transitions
minimal_context: Angelica is expected to complete general classroom instruction assignments early in her ninth-grade year.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please take out your assignment and begin working on the reading questions for today's lesson.

STUDENT: This is boring. I don't see why we have to do this.

TUTOR: Just do your best to get through the questions.

STUDENT: It's pointless. I don't even want to be in this class without my friend.

TUTOR: You need to stay in your seat and finish the work.

STUDENT: No, I'm cutting this class. I'm going to find my friend instead of staying here.

options.A: Terminate the academic demands and remove the assignment materials for ten seconds.
options.B: Provide warnings of upcoming transitions during the general classroom instruction period.
options.C: Provide external regulation to help the student start inhibiting inappropriate urges to leave.
options.D: Take time to explain the assignment, treat the student fairly, speak in an even tone, and recognize effort.
